title: ML Churn Prediction (Flask)
summary: A Flask web application for customer churn prediction, offering single and bulk predictions, an analytics dashboard, and retention email workflows. A separate script, generate_synthetic_data.py, uses SDV's CTGANSynthesizer with SingleTableMetadata to generate 30,000 synthetic customer rows for the model.
